intro_html: The messy sandwich you loved as a kid, grown up into a high-protein rice bowl. Each serving brings 45 grams of protein for about $5.45 (at everyday cost) and the batch makes 14. Same tangy, savory sloppy joe flavor, now built to fuel you instead of just fill you.
cost_closing_html: About $5.45 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Every one of the 14 bowls serves 45 grams of protein at 584 calories, so this childhood favorite pulls real nutritional weight.
upsell_html: Nostalgia in a bowl, portioned and paid off. Some meals just make you smile. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: The sauce is ketchup, tomato paste, and mustard you likely already have, so skip the pricey sloppy joe seasoning packets.
Green bell peppers are the budget pick and give you that classic sloppy joe bite.
Buy tomato sauce and paste in the small cans when they hit their sale price and keep a few in the pantry for recipes like this.
make_it: Brown 5.4 pounds of 93/7 ground beef with the chopped onion and green bell peppers, then drain.
Stir in the tomato sauce, tomato paste, ketchup, dijon, and garlic.
Simmer until the sauce thickens and clings to the meat.
Cook the rice separately so it stays fluffy.
Spoon the sloppy joe beef over the rice in each container.
